about.text: When the results of the 2020 census showed an increased population in DeSoto County, Mississippi, the County began its decennial redistricting process. See Harris v. DeSoto Cnty., No. 3:24-cv-289, 2025 WL 1230460, at *1 (N.D. Miss. Apr. 28, 2025).
